result.name: Pump pressure-test worksheet
result.description: On the bench, a sheet initialed by Owen and Jonah records a pressure test from 20:32 to 20:41, pressure readings and red-primer work. A parts receipt dated 16 October references a £480 maintenance-fund payment. A before-supper note agrees a witnessed test during the evening departure period. The pump bench faces the ferry-office hatch. These records describe work and payment; they are not a tamper-proof alibi or identification of a stain.

result.name: Repayment demand
result.description: In the tool tin is Adrian's folded note: “£480 from the maintenance fund is to be restored before tomorrow's handover. We discuss it 20:25.” It records a demand and deadline, not violent intent.

result.text: I went in at about twenty twenty-six and left before the first bell. He wanted the four hundred and eighty pounds restored before the archive handover. I used the maintenance fund for the rescue pump without permission. I meant to replace it from invoices. Jonah watched the later test; that does not make taking the money right.
